headline: Temple of Ahn'Qiraj in 58:27, the guild's first clear under an hour

mvp.headline: most damage on Skeram and Silithid Royalty, top three on four more
why: First on Skeram (52k) and Silithid Royalty (96k, parse 93)
Second on the Twin Emperors (139k), third on Huhuran, Ouro and C'Thun
Four Poison Bolts soaked on Huhuran

also.text: most healing on Skeram, Viscidus (74k), Huhuran, Ouro (43k) and C'Thun (82k)
3 of Skeram's 11 interrupted Arcane Explosions, and parses of 95 to 96 on the Twins and Ouro

overview: 9 of 9 in 58:27, two minutes under the guild's previous best AQ40 (1:00:47) and seventeen under the usual night (1:18:55). No wipes, 21 deaths, 9 of them on bosses.

C'Thun in 3:31 against a usual 5:16, six seconds off the record, with Eye Beam hitting a third as often as usual. Viscidus in 1:50 with one death, a big step from last week's nine. Fankriss (0:36) and Huhuran (0:40) were close to their records.
The Twin Emperors took 2:40, slower than last week's record 2:09: Heal Brother healed them for 180k, where a usual kill has none in the log, and the Blizzard hit 26 raiders 41 times.
World buffs: none at Skeram and two raiders at Viscidus, while 39 or 40 had Rallying Cry and Zandalar from Royalty on. The usual sign of a Chronoboon.

wentWell.text: C'Thun in 3:31 (median 5:16), 6 seconds off the guild record. Eye Beam hit 0.43 times per raider against a usual 1.2, and only 7 raiders went to the stomach.
11 of Skeram's 12 Arcane Explosions interrupted: Harrylarry 3, Groomz 2.
Viscidus in 1:50 (median 2:00) with one death, and 11.9 Poison Bolt Volley hits per raider against a usual 17.4.
Huhuran in 0:40 (median 0:52), no deaths: 58 Poison Bolts soaked by 22 raiders, 15 Nature Protection Potions, both Frenzies tranquilized.

notes.text: 7 mind controls, Lebh twice. Storestine died to Skeram's melee at 0:10.
One of Yauj's three Great Heals went through and healed her for 50k. 18 Toxic Vapors hits, 5 of them on Shaaw.
1:50 (median 2:00). One death, Redjab to Poison Bolt Volley at 1:37.
Toxin hit 17 raiders 32 times, almost twice the usual rate.
0:40 (median 0:52), no deaths. Punintended and Speldosan tranquilized both Frenzies.
2:40 (median 4:04). Heal Brother healed them for 180k; a usual kill has none.
Storestine died to Vek'lor's Shadow Bolt at 1:59, and Whorm in the Blizzard at 2:28 after five ticks of it.
3:31, six seconds off the record. Eufrasia 203k, parse 98.
Four deaths: Wicckz to an Eye Beam at 0:33, Norgewian at 1:09 after Dark Glare, Redjab to an Eye Tentacle's Mind Flay at 2:28, and Bagayaga to Digestive Acid in the stomach at 3:03.
